description: Quantizer that answers a note with a whole chord, giving the tonic and six degrees above it from the chosen scale

params.text: Chooses which of the sixteen polyphony channels the root and scale knobs are editing, 1 to 16
Switches between one root and scale for every channel and a separate root and scale stored for each of the sixteen
Sets the root note of the scale for the channel being edited
Sets the scale the chord is built from, for the channel being edited

inputs.text: The note the chord is built on, a volt per octave; it is polyphonic, and each channel gets its own chord
0V to 10V moves the root note up through the twelve notes, added to the knob
0V to 10V moves the scale up through the list, added to the knob

outputs.text: The nearest note of the scale to the input, a volt per octave
The third of the chord built on that note

inputs.1:
polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
